abilities.effect_text: This passive ability increases the chance you will strike through your opponent's active defenses, such as dodge, block, parry, and riposte, by 10/20/30%. Requirements: Level 12/30/50.

abilities.name: Weapon Mastery of the Scout
abilities.effect_text: Increases the base damage of your archery attacks by 30/60/100%. Requirements: Level 1.

abilities.name: Chaotic Stab
abilities.effect_text: This passive ability allows your backstab attacks to deal minimal backstab damage if you are not behind your target. Requirements: Level 1.

abilities.name: Escape
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 102 - Refresh Time: 0:05:00 - Ability Timer(s): 89. This ability, when activated, allows you to escape combat from NPCs that are 20 or fewer levels higher than you, causes you to be the last possible target of rampage attacks from any current attacker, and triggers Evader's Invisibility which grants permanent invisibility. This ability consumes 2% of your endurance to activate. Requirements: Level 10.

abilities.name: Innate Sneakiness
abilities.effect_text: Grants the Rogue the ability to move while using Hide, provided that the sneak ability is also active. This allows them to move around unseen by most creatures. Requirements: Level 1.

abilities.name: Purge Poison
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 107 - Refresh Time: 1:12:00 - Ability Timer(s): 12. This ability, when activated, cures you of 1200 poison counters. Requirements: Level 15.

abilities.name: Shroud of Stealth
abilities.effect_text: This passive ability provides you a previously unheard of level of stealth that increases the invisibility offered by your Hide skill to tier 2, shadowing you from creatures that normally see through standard invisibility. Requirements: Level 35.

abilities.name: Unbound Lethality
abilities.effect_text: Gives a passive 10/15/20% bonus to the duration of all poisons. Additionally lowers the resist value of all poisons by 25/50/75. Requirements: Level 12/30/50.

abilities.name: Abyssal Steed
abilities.requirements_raw: Requirements: Level 50, Unholy Steed at Level 1.
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 571 - Refresh Time: 0:00:01 - Ability Timer(s): 0. This ability, when activated, summons the bridle of a very fast Abyssal Nightmare. Requirements: Level 50, Unholy Steed at Level 1.

abilities.name: Harm Touch
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 6000 - Refresh Time: 0:20:00 - Ability Timer(s): 2. Harm Touch II, when activated, grips a non-player target with agony, instantly dealing up to 751 damage based on your current level. Ranks 9 and 10 add a Damage Over Time effect to the target. Requirements: Level 1/6/11/16/21/26/31/36/41/46.

abilities.name: Leech Touch
abilities.effect_text: This passive ability augments the Harm Touch ability by giving it a lifetap effect. Requirements: Level 1.

abilities.name: Soul Abrasion
abilities.effect_text: This passive ability increases the base damage of lifetaps triggered by Vampiric Embrace and Scream of Death by 50/100/200%. Requirements: Level 15.

abilities.name: Unbound Drain
abilities.effect_text: Gives a passive 2/4/6% increase in damage for lifetap spells. Requirements: Level 12/30/50.

abilities.name: Unholy Steed
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 85 - Refresh Time: 0:00:01 - Ability Timer(s): 0. This ability, when activated, summons the bridle of a very fast Unholy Steed. Requirements: Level 20.

abilities.name: Cannibalization
abilities.requirements_raw: Requirements: Level 40, Mental Clarity at Level 3.
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 47 - Refresh Time: 0:03:00 - Ability Timer(s): 2. Cannibalization I, when activated, consumes 1924 health to restore 1066 mana. Requirements: Level 40, Mental Clarity at Level 3.

abilities.name: Unbound Cascade
abilities.effect_text: This passive ability increases the damage dealt by your critical damage over time spells by 10/20/30%. Requirements: Level 12/30/50.

abilities.name: Area Taunt
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 110 - Refresh Time: 0:05:00 - Ability Timer(s): 2. Area Taunt I, when activated, taunts all creatures within a 40 foot radius, placing you 100 points of hate higher than your opponents' previously most hated target. Requirements: Level 25.

abilities.name: Heroic Leap
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 2016 - Refresh Time: 0:00:30 - Ability Timer(s): 9. Heroic Leap I, when activated, causes you to leap approximately 10 feet in front of your target, attracting the attention of up to 8 opponents within a 40 foot radius of your target, increasing their hatred for you by 1250 points. Requirements: Level 12.

abilities.name: Innate Fighters Tenacity
abilities.effect_text: Grants the Warrior the ability to go into a frenzy at low health, increasing critical strike chance, and also permanently mitigate 5% of all incoming melee damage. Below 35% health, the warrior goes into a berserker frenzy, gaining increased chance to hit, and turns their critical attacks into crippling blows, which deal increased damage, and can stun the target. The warrior will remain in this state until their health reaches 45%. Requirements: Level 1.

abilities.name: Unbound Wrath
abilities.effect_text: This passive ability increases your melee critical hit damage by 10/20/30%. Requirements: Level 12/30/50.

abilities.name: War Cry
abilities.requirements_raw: Requirements: Level 25, Fear Resistance at Level 3.
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 111 - Refresh Time: 0:36:00 - Ability Timer(s): 3. War Cry I, when activated, grants all group members within a 100 foot radius immunity to fear spells for 10 seconds. Requirements: Level 25, Fear Resistance at Level 3.

abilities.name: Warrior's Endurance
abilities.effect_text: This passive ability increases your hit point regeneration by 1% per 6 seconds. Requirements: Level 30.

abilities.name: Improved Familiar
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 52 - Refresh Time: 0:01:00 - Ability Timer(s): 8. Improved Familiar I, which when activated, triggers Summon Improved Familiar I, the physical manifestation of your familiar, increases the damage dealt by your critical direct damage spells by 3%, the casting levels of your spells by 9, your cold, disease, fire, magic, and poison resistances by 25 points, your mana regeneration by 6 points, your maximum mana by 200 points, and allows you to see invisible creatures. Requirements: Level 45.

abilities.name: Mana Burn
abilities.requirements_raw: Requirements: Level 45, Mental Clarity at Level 3.
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 565 - Refresh Time: 1:12:00 - Ability Timer(s): 7. Mana Burn I, when activated, consumes up to 3000 mana to deal 4x of the consumed mana as direct damage and prevents additional Mana Burn spells from landing on that target for 0:01:00. Requirements: Level 45, Mental Clarity at Level 3.

abilities.name: Quick Evacuation
abilities.effect_text: This passive ability reduces the cast time of your evacuation and succor spells and abilities by 10/?/?%. Requirements: Level 1.

abilities.name: Strong Root
abilities.effect_text: Ability Activation ID: 117 - Refresh Time: 1:12:00 - Ability Timer(s): 2. This ability, when activated, roots your target in place for up to 48 seconds with a 300 point resist modifier and a 2 second cast time. Requirements: Level 35.

abilities.name: Unbound Destruction
abilities.effect_text: This passive ability increases your chance to land a critical hit with your direct damage spells by 2/4/6%. Requirements: Level 12/30/50.

abilities.name: Banestrike
abilities.effect_text: This passive ability improves the base damage of your melee attacks and the power of your damaging and healing abilities by 2/4/?/?%. Complete Slayer achievements to progress this ability. Requirements: Level 1.
